notablePrerequisites: Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.You control at least two additional creatures.
description:
During your upkeep, activate Necrotic Ooze using Whisper's ability by tapping it and sacrificing two other creatures, returning Eyeblight Cullers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Black Carriage's ability by sacrificing Eyeblight Cullers, untapping Necrotic Ooze.
Eyeblight Cullers dies, creating three 1/1 Elf Warrior creature tokens and causing you to mill three cards.
Repeat.
